description: Haystack pipeline with a prompt builder and a generator, traced by OpenInference.
notes: Only HaystackInstrumentor is enabled. The openai instrumentor would add a second llm span for the call, and the call would count twice; the page says not to enable it. HAYSTACK_TELEMETRY_ENABLED is False, set in main.py before haystack is imported, so no telemetry leaves the process. The pipeline is ChatPromptBuilder into OpenAIChatGenerator, pointed at the mock. The tree is Pipeline.run [chain] over ChatPromptBuilder.run [chain] and OpenAIChatGenerator.run [llm]. The instrumentor traces pipelines only: the page says the Agent component is not traced as an agent, and its model calls appear as separate traces.
